rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 8 and 11: the prototype (DR2.1) wins by default over what the real services do today, and only a DR1 judgement on the same difference or a real constraint the prototype cannot express overrides it; neither applies to which transporter pages carry the status strip, and 'may be an oversight' is not an override.
outcome: Follow DR2.1 page by page: 'Choose a transporter type' and 'Add a private transporter' show no notification status strip, while the transporter list and 'Add a commercial transporter' keep it. The prototype wins by default; no DR1 judgement covers this difference and no persistence, validation, authentication or cross-service constraint is involved, so today's strip on every transporter page gives way.
